taxonomy_of_failure_modes.incorrect_search_query: Model generates ambiguous or overly narrow query string.

taxonomy_of_failure_modes.failure_to_extract_evidence: Evidence was present in snippet but model selected wrong number or entity.
taxonomy_of_failure_modes.incorrect_python_computation: Python code executed without error but implemented the wrong formula.
taxonomy_of_failure_modes.intermediate_transfer_failure: Information retrieved in Stage 1 was not transferred into Stage 2 computation.

taxonomy_of_failure_modes.citation_grounding_failure: Response made claims unsupported by or conflicting with retrieved URLs.
